documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V4.0: PLA Aero
Bambu PLA Aero Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127A11
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 18 ± 3 MPa, elongation 1.2 ± 0.4 %, bending modulus 1410 ± 80 MPa, bending strength 17 ± 3 MPa, impact 3.1 ± 0.7 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density ("(filament)", ISO 1183) and the DSC melting and glass transition temperatures are raw-material properties and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows; the TDS does not state the specimen form for Vicat and HDT, and their test_condition says so.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1350 ± 250 MPa, Z 1240 ± 180 MPa), melt index (7.7 ± 0.6 g/10 min at 260 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), heat deflection temperature 53 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.45% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), nozzle size (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm; see the nozzle relations), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), the heatbed drying line (X1 Series Printer Heatbed: 65 - 75 °C, 12 h), suggested annealing (50 to 55 °C, 6 to 12 hours; not recommended for very light and thin prints), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

The TDS "Bed Surface Preparation Glue" is a recommended setting, not a stated requirement, so no "requires" relation is written. The material-table wiki's Engineering Plate column (generic PLA, "45 - 65 ℃ Glue Required") is not written as a relation: the product TDS does not list the Engineering Plate.

Nozzle disagreement left to review: the TDS lists nozzle sizes 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm; the store FAQ says not compatible with hardened steel 0.6 / 0.8 mm and stainless steel 0.2 mm nozzles; the PLA wiki says "Only compatible with 0.4 mm nozzles". The relations follow the store page and the PLA wiki and carry the TDS row as a conflict.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: CLP "Not classified", no PBT/vPvB substance, transport and disposal text. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values. The SDS model "A11-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : A11-xx(xx stands for any suffix)") is not written to identity.model: the builder writes identity.model "PLA Aero" from the reviewed identity map (§C.1), which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace, and "A11-xx" is a designation with a wildcard suffix, not this product's model.

The material-table wiki has no PLA Aero row; Table Note ② counts PLA Aero as standard "PLA". Its generic PLA values (nozzle 190 - 240 °C, bed temperatures per plate, 55 ℃ for 8 h oven drying) were used only as corroboration or recorded as disagreements.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Low Density and Light Weight", "prints density is only 50% to 80%", "about half the weight of PLA Basic", "Tough with Good Impact Resistance" and "Matte Finish For Easy Coloring" (store page) are not stored as values.

The store page's "Parameters Comparison" table (PLA Aero against PLA Basic; format C, not parsed by the deterministic layer) gives for PLA Aero: Printing Temperature 220 - 260 ℃ (the TDS says 210 - 260 °C: recorded as the conflict on print_settings.nozzle_temp), Printing Speed < 180 mm/s and Filament Density 1.21 g/cm³ (both agree with the TDS), and Flow Rate Ratio 0.5 - 0.8, Foaming Rate 0 - 120% and Prints Density 0.55 - 1.05 g/cm³ (slicer and printed-part values with no registry key, not stored).

The PLA wiki §5.3 foaming table (print temperature 190 - 270 °C against minimum flow ratio, maximum volume expansion rate, maximum foaming rate and minimum print density 1.17 - 0.42 g/cm³) and the store page's foaming chart describe printed parts; no registry key holds them and they are not stored.
Hex: the store page links no Hex Code document for PLA Aero and none was cached, so no published hex is curated for its two colours (White (14102), Gray (14104)).

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/c60370b45f9c4f628df6f5f69eeb4601.pdf) and the wiki page "instructions for printing aircraft model with foaming PLA (PLA Aero)" (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/knowledge-sharing/studio-settings-for-rc-models); neither was cached or read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

material.spool_type is not curated and not marked not_published: the store page's Type value "Filament with spool" is the deterministic layer's, and the TDS rows "Spool Material ABS (Temperature resistance 70 °C)" and "Spool Size Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm" give the spool's material and size, not its type (the registry key mirrors the select With spool / Refill / Cardboard).
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store FAQ (5.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade" and the PLA wiki says only PLA Pure is food-contact grade; no registry key holds it.

Adjudication against the independent second extraction (67 field disagreements; every disputed fact re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, PLA wiki, material-table wiki and store page): locator wording ("p.1, Specifications › …" kept over "p.1 › Specifications › …"), the material.type wording ("Polylactic acid", the TDS p.3 Composition cell, not "PLA (polylactic acid)"), the AMS-series target label and the single store-FAQ relation for the 0.6 / 0.8 mm hardened steel nozzles keep this file's form. thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (48 °C), as in every other filament file; the 0.45 MPa row (53 °C) is noted. material.net_weight is written as 1 kg, the TDS's own figure (the quote checker flagged 1000 g against the quote "1 kg"); the merge stores 1000 g. Not added from the second extraction: material.spool_type (the TDS spool material and size, see above), identity.model (the SDS pattern, see the SDS note) and the open-frame / enclosed printer relations (the PLA wiki's product row "All printers compatible" is kept and the material-table rows are cited in its note). Kept after reading the documents, though the second extraction lacked them: the all-printers and 0.4 mm nozzle relations (PLA wiki 1.1, row "PLA Aero") and the Cool Plate, High Temperature Plate and Textured PEI Plate relations (TDS p.1 Bed Type row). Second adjudication pass (every fact re-checked in the cached documents): no value changed; the earlier notes saying the store page states no nozzle temperature or print speed were wrong (its "Parameters Comparison" table states both) and are corrected, and the nozzle and bed temperature disagreements now sit in each row's conflict field, as in the other filament files.
